failures.cause: Nothing in the @field_validator migration caused this; pyproject.toml addopts includes --cov=smart_schema but fleetmigrate CI only installs pytest and coverage (not pytest-cov), so pytest aborts before any test runs.
failures.fix: Either remove --cov=smart_schema from [tool.pytest.ini_options].addopts (CI already wraps pytest with coverage run) or extend the fleetmigrate install step to pip install pytest-cov; no further validator code changes are required for tests to pass once pytest starts.
